purpose: Canonical controller boundary for one serialized lifecycle and cascade transition.

snapshot.rule: The aggregate snapshot is the canonical crash-recovery record. Lifecycle, cascade, and bridge projections may be retained for inspection, but a restart must load and validate this single content-addressed snapshot before accepting a transition.

policy_boundary.rule: An approved policy amendment is not merely metadata. The canonical state-owner boundary derives the current and next campaign projections, computes stale sessions, rotations, invalidated questions, and recompile targets, and returns the exact assignment action set before a controller may issue new leases. A stale parent or boundary is rejected.

rule: The state owner validates complete current lifecycle and cascade states, applies the paired transitions, validates the resulting states, and emits a bridge whose compact identities reference both resulting state digests. A caller cannot advance only one state machine through the canonical controller. The aggregate snapshot is written by one staged temporary file and atomic rename with compare-and-swap; separate projections remain an optional compatibility/readability export and are not the crash-recovery authority.
